name: Modified M9 minimal medium (screening) (PMC11039988)
description: Modified M9 minimal medium (screening), a defined medium extracted from Gawlitt et al. (2024). Mapped to BiGG from the paper's stated composition.

provenance.citation: Gawlitt et al. Expanding the flexibility of base editing for high-throughput genetic screens in bacteria. Nucleic Acids Research (2024). DOI: 10.1093/nar/gkae174. [PMC11039988]
provenance.notes: Extracted from the primary paper (snippet: For screening in minimal media, M9 minimal medium (1× M9 salts, 1 mM thiamine hydrochloride, 0.4% glucose, 0.2% casamino acids, 2 mM MgSO4, 0.1 mM CaCl2) and MOPS minimal medium [prepared as described). Component names mapped to BiGG (see mapping_confidence); presence-based bounds unless the paper gave exchange bounds; concentration_mM where units allowed. Extraction confidence: high.
provenance.base_expansion: Base 'M9' expanded to standard composition: M9 minimal medium (Sambrook & Russell 2001): Na2HPO4, KH2PO4, NaCl, NH4Cl, MgSO4, CaCl2 + carbon source.
provenance.verification_evidence: M9 minimal medium (1× M9 salts, 1 mM thiamine hydrochloride, 0.4% glucose, 0.2% casamino acids, 2 mM MgSO4, 0.1 mM CaCl2) and MOPS minimal medium [prepared as described in (43) with 0.4% glucose] were prepared freshly prior to the screen.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all divides components by (components + unresolved ingredients). It counts pipeline-derived components as covered, so it is not a measure of how much of the source's own ingredient list was captured. pct_covered_source divides source-stated components by (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components), which is that measure. Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
